currentLaw.kamerverhuur: Current plan explicitly regulates existing/approved room-rental properties and requires an omgevingsvergunning for a new kamerverhuurpand or an increase in the number of rooms.
currentLaw.splitting: Current plan states that existing dwellings may not be structurally split into multiple ground-bound dwellings in the relevant residential working areas.
currentLaw.apartments: Current plan separately regulates the realization/use of apartments, including a prohibition subject to exceptions/permit structure in the applicable working areas.
currentLaw.policyLink: The permit assessment for room rental explicitly refers to Beleidsregel Onzelfstandige bewoning Enschede 2022 or its successor.

storage.upTo4Rooms: at least 6 m2 reachable indoor/outdoor storage on own property
storage.5OrMoreRooms: at least 7 m2 plus 1 m2 for every extra room

substantiveKamerverhuur.liveability: Municipality must find no vulnerable residential/living-climate situation; assessment uses the current/successor onzelfstandige-bewoning policy.
substantiveKamerverhuur.extinctionRule: A qualifying existing/approved room-rental use may not be restarted after interruption for one year or more under the plan's extinction provision.
substantiveKamerverhuur.overcrowding: General plan rule: dwelling not occupied by more than one person per 12 m2 use area, subject to stated exception.

application.route: Check and apply through Omgevingsloket. A concept request can first be submitted for activities where available; municipality also offers preliminary discussion/help routes.
kamerverhuurDocuments: total number of separately rentable rooms
for existing/approved room-rental property: current number of separately rented rooms
floor plan showing total room-rental use area in proposed situation
numbered rentable rooms with area per room
indoor/outdoor storage area with its surface area
other spaces with area per space
application.conceptRequestFee: EUR 317.30 according to the current municipal Omgevingsvergunning page checked 2026-08-11.
application.permitFee: Exact permit amount is activity-dependent and must be taken from the current Legesverordening Omgevingswet 2026/tariff table; not generalized here.
application.participation: Municipality instructs initiators to involve/inform the neighbourhood before applying for building/initiative plans where relevant.

fees.qualityRule: The regulation has a separate tariff table; exact activity tariff is not encoded until the applicable line for the concrete permit branch is positively matched.
fees.knownStableAmount: Concept request EUR 317.30 from current municipal product page.

specialCases.monuments: For monument alterations, concept consultation is recommended; application goes through Omgevingsloket and bouwhistorisch onderzoek may be relevant. Municipal-monument permit information gives an 8-week period with possible one-time 6-week extension for that branch.
specialCases.bibob: Bibob data are an explicit application requirement for the room-rental permit under the current Omgevingsplan.

currentnessQA.oldTemporaryPolicy2020: Not used as current controlling policy; historical source only.
currentnessQA.policy2022Reference: The current Omgevingsplan itself refers to Onzelfstandige bewoning Enschede 2022 or a successor, so successor/currentness must be checked whenever the policy is updated.
currentnessQA.articleNumbering: Current plan versions show article numbering can shift between versions; product logic should identify rule by stable subject/source and verify current article number rather than hard-code a historical number indefinitely.

remainingAllowedOnly: exact permit tariff for the selected activity branch
case-specific building/fire-safety/monument/parking or other studies generated by the concrete project
successor-policy watch for Onzelfstandige bewoning Enschede 2022
